propositions: Provider-prefixed model references (e.g. anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6) passed to genai_prices.calc_price raise LookupError and silently drop rows from cost totals without warning
Anthropic and OpenAI usage rows render as unpriced while Bedrock rows price correctly, creating asymmetric bias in provider cost comparisons
The LookupError exception is caught and converted to unpriced status without distinguishing between genuinely unknown models and malformed provider-qualified ids
Model id translation must be decided by registry membership rather than prefix matching to handle versioned AWS ids like anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0
Usage rows with resolvable model ids should price correctly when provider-qualification is stripped via provider-aware translation before passing to genai_prices
